elements.requirement: An individual who makes a claim is entitled to a personal allowance of £12,570 for a tax year if that individual meets the requirements of section 56 (residence etc).
elements.quote: An individual who makes a claim is entitled to a personal allowance of £12,570 for a tax year if the individual meets the requirements of section 56

elements.requirement: An individual whose adjusted net income exceeds £100,000 has their personal allowance reduced by one-half of the excess over £100,000.
elements.quote: For an individual whose adjusted net income exceeds £100,000, the allowance under subsection (1) is reduced by one-half of the excess.

elements.requirement: An allowance that remains after the reduction for adjusted net income exceeding £100,000 must be rounded up to the nearest amount which is a multiple of £1 if it would otherwise not be a multiple of £1.
elements.quote: If the amount of any allowance that remains after the operation of subsection (2) would otherwise not be a multiple of £1, it is to be rounded up to the nearest amount which is a multiple of £1.

elements.requirement: The definition and meaning of “adjusted net income” is provided in section 58.
elements.quote: For the meaning of “adjusted net income” see section 58.

thresholds.quote: personal allowance of £12,570 for a tax year
